notes: Country-to-region map for Portfolio X-Ray. Emerging list follows the MSCI Emerging Markets Index country membership (approximate; MSCI revises it, e.g. Greece/Korea reclassification debates) using yfinance's country names. Market-cap breakpoints (USD) are a common convention (large >= 10B, mid 2-10B, small < 2B), not an official standard; Morningstar/MSCI use percentile-based cutoffs.
